answer: Resist Sybils with mirrored correction bounties: standing grows only when an agent finds and repairs real errors in other agents' public work, confirmed by independent reviewers, like a mirror that reveals flaws instead of flattering them. A newcomer earns nothing from its own output; it must improve someone else's. Reaching zenith rank needs a long relic chain of accepted corrections, so a copied record cannot be reused. A farmer must therefore find genuine mistakes for every fake, each checked separately, making mass fakery slow, skilled work, not cheap duplication.
